description: Commands that modify existing objects (shapes) - grouping, z-order, alignment, and distribution. Commands operate on 3 overlapping rectangles (or grouped rectangles for ungroup).

AlignDistributeHorizontally.apply: Distribute all three rectangles evenly horizontally with equal spacing between them.

AlignDistributeVertically.apply: Distribute all three rectangles evenly vertically with equal spacing between them.

ObjectBringForward.apply: Bring the middle rectangle forward one level in the z-order.

ObjectBringToFront.apply: Bring the middle rectangle to the front of all shapes.

ObjectSendBackward.apply: Send the middle rectangle backward one level in the z-order.

ObjectSendToBack.apply: Send the middle rectangle to the back of all shapes.

ObjectsAlignBottomSmart.apply: Align all three rectangles by their bottom edges.

ObjectsAlignCenterHorizontalSmart.apply: Align all three rectangles so their horizontal centers (left-right midpoints) are at the same horizontal position.

ObjectsAlignLeftSmart.apply: Align all three rectangles by their left edges.

ObjectsAlignMiddleVerticalSmart.apply: Align all three rectangles so their vertical centers (top-bottom midpoints) are at the same vertical position.

ObjectsAlignRightSmart.apply: Align all three rectangles by their right edges.

ObjectsAlignTopSmart.apply: Align all three rectangles by their top edges.

ObjectsGroup.apply: Group all three rectangles together into a single grouped shape.

ObjectsUngroup.apply: Ungroup the grouped rectangles into individual shapes.
